summed_identity: Both endpoint potentials contribute once to each unordered edge weight. Negative edge terms can be discarded because edges are nonnegative; each positive term may be allocated to either endpoint selector by activation.
fixed_selection_lift: Zero potentials outside the saved set and allocation of crossing edges to absent endpoints yield the exact internal-edge support-function gap. The resulting selector cut is valid at every selection.
completeness_scope: The image of the finite edge box is a compact rational polytope. Strict separation supplies a real potential, rational approximation preserves a positive gap, and scaling gives integer potentials. This detects symmetric real-row infeasibility, not arbitrary integrality or pair-cap failures.
signature_uniqueness: Both domains have at least three core neighbors per column, so repeated columns violate the common-neighbor upper bound.
